DESCRIPTION:
Our streaming product renews every month or year. We want to know which subscribers will cancel. Each row is one subscriber. The churned column says yes when the subscriber cancelled. The score is needed at renewal time; refunds are paid only after a cancellation. We care most about AUC.

FILES (headers only):
subscribers.csv: subscriber_id, signup_time, plan, monthly_fee, tenure_months, support_calls, late_payments, final_refund_amount, churned

DESCRIPTION:
Our support desk receives tickets from web, email and chat. The goal is to stop tickets bouncing between teams. The target is assigned_team, the team that finally handled it. Routing happens when the ticket is created, before anyone reads it. We will judge it by macro F1, since small teams matter too.

FILES (headers only):
tickets.csv: ticket_id, created_at, customer_id, plan, channel, product_area, subject_words, body_words, has_attachment, mentions_invoice, mentions_password, mentions_error, mentions_parcel, mentions_export, mentions_contract, resolved_by, first_response_minutes, assigned_team

The router will place the ticket in that team's queue. assigned_team is the label we want to predict. Routing happens when the ticket is created, before anyone reads it. Customers often open many tickets, so customer_id repeats. We will judge it by macro F1, since small teams matter too.
